s: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 made which city the sole, permanent capital of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 amended Section 5 to make Amaravati the sole, permanent capital of AP with effect from 2 June 2024.

new.s: Which railway zone, India's 18th, became operational on 1 June 2026 with headquarters at Visakhapatnam?
new.x: South Coast Railway, the 18th railway zone with HQ at Visakhapatnam, became operational on 1 June 2026.

new.s: Where is the headquarters of the South Coast Railway zone that became operational in June 2026?
new.x: The South Coast Railway (18th zone) has its headquarters at Visakhapatnam.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's number of districts rose to how many on 31 December 2025?
new.x: AP's districts went from 26 to 28 on 31 Dec 2025 with the new Polavaram and Markapuram districts.

new.s: Which two new districts were formed in Andhra Pradesh on 31 December 2025?
new.x: Polavaram (HQ Rampachodavaram) and Markapuram became AP's 27th and 28th districts on 31 Dec 2025.

new.s: What is the headquarters of the new Polavaram district formed in Andhra Pradesh in December 2025?
new.x: The new Polavaram district has its headquarters at Rampachodavaram.
